title: Q1
description:
Hebrews speaks of three rests: Yahweh's rest in Psa 95 (“My rest”), the seventh-day rest of Gen 2:2, and the rest in the land under Joshua. Hebrews says (4:8): “For if Joshua had given them rest, then He would not afterward have spoken of another day.”
Read: Psa 95:11, Gen 2:2, Jos 21:43–45, Jos 23:1
a) Joshua says Yahweh “gave them rest all around.” What does that background bring forward, and why does Hebrews still say a greater rest remains?
